messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: Stan command quick start
parts:
In Stan: command quick start, it writes that we can do 

% make -f <stan-home>/makefile <path-to-model>

But it seems not for me, I have different problems with it when in different folder other than stan-home. 

jq@jq-tpw510:~/Desktop/stan/rstan$ make -f ../makefile  tmp/hmvn
g++     tmp/hmvn.cpp  -Lbin -lstan -o tmp/hmvn
tmp/hmvn.cpp:3:39: fatal error: stan/model/model_header.hpp: No such file or directory
compilation terminated.
make: *** [tmp/hmvn] Error 1
jq@jq-tpw510:~/Desktop/stan/rstan$ cd tmp
jq@jq-tpw510:~/Desktop/stan/rstan/tmp$ make -f ../../makefile hmvn
g++ -I src -I lib/eigen_3.1.1 -I lib/boost_1.51.0 -O3 -Wall   -c -o hmvn.o hmvn.cpp
hmvn.cpp:3:39: fatal error: stan/model/model_header.hpp: No such file or directory
compilation terminated.

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: Stan command quick start
parts:
I should have double checked that. I think that won't work. I think what does work is:

% cd <stan-home>
% make <path-to-model>

What we can do is create a variable that indicates STAN_HOME for us to include source files relative to that path. We'll talk about it in a few mins.


Daniel
